outcome: severe fetal growth restriction with Doppler changes
cohort: The study included antenatal women identified as high risk for preeclampsia.
finding: An increased sFlt-1/PlGF ratio was a good predictive marker for severe adverse materno-fetal outcome in high-risk women, with better accuracy for complications occurring before 34 weeks of gestation.
followup_time: Until delivery and early neonatal period
